spans.s: ठच tad. affix इक or क (by
) with the vowel अ accented acute applied to (1) कुमुद and others as a Caturarthika affix; cf.
; (2) to multisyllabic words and words beginning with उप which are proper nouns for persons; cf.
, 80; and (3) to the word एकशाला in the sense of इव; cf.

. The base, to which टच् is added, retains generally two sylla- bles or sometimes three, the rest being elided before the affix ठच् e. g. देविकः, वायुकः, पितृकः शेबलिकः etc. from the words देवदत्त, वायुदत्त, पितृ- दत्त, शेवलदत्त etc.; cf. P. V,3.83, 84.
